title: I Used 100 Autonomous AI Agents To Run A Million Dollar Company Solo
description:
What if you could run an entire company with zero employees? Solo founders are building million-dollar businesses using armies of AI agents.

In this video, we break down:
- The architecture: how 100 specialized AI agents work together
- Real examples: Pieter Levels ($420K/mo), Base44 ($80M exit), Marc Lou ($1M/yr)
- The frameworks: CrewAI ($18M Series A), AutoGen, LangGraph
- The cost math: $3K-12K/year vs $200K+ for human teams
- The honest limitations: error rates, orchestration complexity

This isn't theoretical. It's happening right now.

Sources:
